local_checks.result: deploy-kit applies the pending targets under ~/.local/bin, ~/.agents and ~/.dsh by name (deploy-kit.sh:44, 135-145) and states that a named apply does not run the source's run_ scripts (16-18); it pulls nothing (Makefile:166, README.md:203) and makes no comparison of the source with origin/main of its own.
